description: This file defines a class Vtiger_PDF_HeaderViewer responsible for rendering header views in PDF documents in the vtiger CRM project. It manages whether headers are shown on every page or just the first, calculates height, and handles display logic for headers.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_HeaderViewer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and managing header sections in PDF documents within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: setOnEveryPage
methods.description: Sets the header to be displayed on every page.

methods.name: onEveryPage
methods.description: Enables header display on every page.

methods.name: setOnFirstPage
methods.description: Sets the header to display only on the first page.

methods.name: onFirstPage
methods.description: Enables header display only on the first page.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Assigns a model object for header content.

methods.name: totalHeight
methods.description: Calculates total height of the header based on content and configuration.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the display settings for rendering the header.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the header content into the PDF using the provided parent context.
